verdict.rationale: First-party docs show the core loop. Campaigns are composed in a no-code builder or by pasting HTML, an audience is set by recipient list (via the API) or by segmenting and filtering contacts, and the email is then sent. Scheduling a send for later is not documented; the only scheduling mention is analytics for choosing peak engagement times, not a schedule-send feature. Missing for 10: documented campaign scheduling (send at a future time), explicit in-app audience/list selection at send time, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can compose an email campaign, pick its audience, and send or schedule it — the arena's table-stakes loop

citations.quote: Professionally built emails - no coding required.
Paste or upload your HTML, check the live preview, and send.
Set up the campaign name, subject line, sender details, and recipient list via the API.
Segment and filter contacts by what they care about.
open it in Benchmark to make final edits and send.
